family.amstrad-sinclair-apc.description: Sinclair- and Amstrad-branded desktop PCs related to Amstrad’s Generation 3 range.
family.amstrad-sinclair-apc.history: The APC 286 and APC 386SX share a front-panel design. Factory labels and surviving specimens link them to the PC3286 and PC3386SX respectively. Generation 3 documentation dates to 1990. The APC launch date remains unconfirmed.
